lessons_learned: When applying click-outside listeners to sidebars, always whitelist the toggle buttons to prevent immediate collapse-and-reopen cycles.

task: SOLID Refactoring of AgentService
hurdles_regression: Preserving existing unit tests that mock/patch classmethods and staticmethods on the main AgentService class.
resolution: Retained the exact classmethod/staticmethod signatures on AgentService and implemented it as a Facade delegating to support services.
lessons_learned: When refactoring core service modules, keep a backward-compatible class facade so that existing test mocks do not break.

task: Consolidate strategic docs into unified strategy.md
hurdles_regression: Merging distinct strategic reports into a concise, token-optimized file without losing vital architecture and rules context.
resolution: Organized the consolidated strategy.md using telegraphic markdown structures grouped by product planes, memory schemas, and behavioral rules.
lessons_learned: Structuring multiple verbose design/strategic files into a single telegraphic reference simplifies context injection and avoids LLM attention bottlenecks.

task: Align agent workflows with Memory OS & Strategy v3.0
hurdles_regression: Outdated test in test_credentials_store.py was mocking get_db_path on DatabaseClient which does not exist.
resolution: Overrode DatabaseClient.__init__ in TestCredentialsStore.setUp to default to the temp DB path and clean up in tearDown.
lessons_learned: Always verify that test suites mock active, actual method signatures. Maintain unit test integrity while doing major documentation changes.

task: Migration-safe ingestion connector normalization layer
hurdles_regression: The handoff requested YouTube API hooks, but the available local implementation is the existing YouTubeScraperEngine path and live source_records persistence is still gated by migration approval.
resolution: Implemented connectors as source-record-shaped normalization with no live DB writes; marked the existing YouTube adapter as Tier E and left official Tier A API work as a separate next step.
lessons_learned: Do not label scraper-backed ingestion as official API ingestion. Keep connector parsing, policy metadata, and persistence wiring separate while migration approval is blocked.

task: Memory OS deep topic study doctrine and analytics primitive
hurdles_regression: The user principle was broad and could have caused unbounded architecture changes or schema work.
resolution: Captured the doctrine in strategy/KB/memory and implemented a deterministic topic-study analytics command over existing SQLite video data without schema changes or new dependencies.
lessons_learned: Deep topic analysis should start with bounded corpus scoring, evidence rows, probability-like ratios, correlations, anomalies, and caveats before LLM interpretation.

task: Data Access Experiment Loop doctrine and method ranking primitive
hurdles_regression: The user principle says the OS should explore many data-reading methods, but unrestricted 'any data' would conflict with governance and misuse boundaries.
resolution: Implemented a governed file-backed JSONL experiment log and method-ranking CLI that blocks Tier X and scores permitted methods by reliability, throughput, cost, errors, and sample count.
lessons_learned: Data-access methods should be treated as measurable experiments first, then promoted into reusable connectors only after logs show reliable performance.

task: Data Access Method Review API and snapshot command
hurdles_regression: Method ranking existed only as a manual CLI, so schedulers and dashboards could not consume it through stable project interfaces.
resolution: Added protected read and snapshot-trigger analytics endpoints plus an atomic JSON snapshot command, all backed by the same file-based method evaluator.
lessons_learned: Promotion and retirement insights should be derived once in a service layer and reused by CLI, API, scheduler, and future UI panels.

task: Operator Runtime Data Method Review panel
hurdles_regression: The method-review API was available but invisible in the dashboard, while the project still forbids live DB migrations and background scheduler daemons without explicit approval.
resolution: Added a read-only Operator Runtime review panel and explicit admin Run action that calls the existing snapshot endpoint; kept review state separate from governance registry readiness.
lessons_learned: Operational analytics panels should display ranked method evidence without exposing raw experiment logs and should not let missing optional logs mark core governance readiness as failed.

task: Thumbnail OCR Gemini model drift fallback
hurdles_regression: Runtime logs showed local Tesseract missing and Gemini OCR fallback failing with 404 because `gemini-1.5-flash` is no longer available for the configured API path.
resolution: Replaced the hard-coded OCR model with configurable current Flash candidates, request-level key params, 404 fallback across candidates, and one `models.list` discovery retry for models supporting `generateContent`.
lessons_learned: Provider-specific OCR paths should not hard-code a single generative model; discover or configure model IDs and stop retries on auth/quota errors.

task: Product and memos workflow split with 12-step scale
hurdles_regression: Existing agent tiers were coarse and agent-specific, so they did not cleanly separate customer product work from Memory OS development work or leave room for very small local-model tasks.
resolution: Added a canonical workflow routing document with `product` and `memos` tracks, a 1-12 `nano` to `giant` scale, trigger syntax, hard limits, examples, and mixed-task handling; updated onboarding pointers.
lessons_learned: Workflow routing should classify both domain and step size before model choice so small local experiments, Codex implementation steps, and max-limit architecture passes do not share the same contract.

task: Task capsule validator
hurdles_regression: Task capsules were only informally parsed, so workflow and 12-step metadata could drift after the new product/memos routing contract.
resolution: Added a standalone JSONL validator with required-field checks and optional workflow, step_score, and step_name validation; added it to the handoff checklist.
lessons_learned: Memos metadata should be validated as a lightweight contract while staying backward-compatible with older capsule rows.

task: Require workflow metadata for new task capsules
hurdles_regression: The validator accepted optional workflow metadata, but the logging rule still described only the legacy capsule schema.
resolution: Updated the capsule logging rule so new rows should include workflow, step_score, and step_name while preserving backward compatibility for old rows.
lessons_learned: Validation and authoring rules should change together; otherwise optional metadata stays unused.

task: Set handoff target to memos nano
hurdles_regression: The handoff still used an ambiguous next-tier instruction after the workflow scale was introduced.
resolution: Set the next handoff target explicitly to memos nano and limited scope to read/classify/TODO-level work.
lessons_learned: Nano handoffs should remove ambiguity and prevent accidental implementation by weak or constrained models.

task: Add Memory OS Kernel, ADR-004, and MVP v0.1 deliverables to global roadmap
hurdles_regression: None. The new roadmap targets are aligned with strategy.md and workflows.md.
resolution: Added specific checklist tasks for ADR-004 and the MVP v0.1 core package, then updated the handoff file for the next memos task.
lessons_learned: Roadmap updates for new capabilities should be concrete, defining schemas and utility scripts before execution begins.

task: Token-Optimized RAG & Memory Architecture
hurdles_regression: Initial implementation of strip_whitespace_noise was executed before stripping individual line leading spaces, causing indentation spaces to prevent collapsing consecutive blank lines.
resolution: Adjusted strip_whitespace_noise to perform line-level stripping first to normalize empty lines, then run collapse substitution, and strip leading/trailing text margins.
lessons_learned: When parsing multiline strings or indentation-rich layouts, always normalize line-level margins and spaces before collapsing consecutive newline boundaries.

task: Governance Registry Database Isolation
hurdles_regression: SQLite cross-database join on videos in list_evidence_links fails once database files are separated.
resolution: Removed videos join from the SQL query and performed dictionary mapping of video titles in Python by querying the main youtube_news.db separately.
lessons_learned: When isolating SQLite databases, maintain logical relationships in application memory/Python mapping rather than relying on attached database files or cross-database joins.

task: Retrieval Router Optimization
hurdles_regression: Existing graph memory tests broke because search_memory return type changed from list-of-nodes to dictionary of lists.
resolution: Refactored search results to output a unified flat list of node dicts, mapping codebase file matches to nodes of type 'code_file' with exact symbol metadata.
lessons_learned: When extending core library retrieval APIs, keep the return type signature backward-compatible (e.g. flat list-of-node shapes) to prevent breaking legacy test consumers.

task: Memory OS Lifecycle transition event order fix and translations
hurdles_regression: Transition event list concatenation in lifecycle.py was reversing chronological order of events, breaking TestMemoryLifecycle assertions.
resolution: Modified cmd_transition to update pending events in-place in the loaded events list and append new events at the end before writing, and added missing translation keys in translations.js.
lessons_learned: To preserve sequence order in file-backed event logs, mutate loaded lists in place rather than separating and prepending/appending sub-lists.

task: Document isolated DB joins, log sequence mutation, and retrieval compatibility rules
hurdles_regression: Architectural learnings from isolated SQLite databases, event log list manipulation, and retrieval router schema updates were undocumented.
resolution: Added Pattern 2 (Retrieval API Backward Compatibility) under RAG-Friendly Code, and Gotchas 4 (SQLite Database Isolation Joins) and 5 (Chronological File Event Journaling) under Known Gotchas.
lessons_learned: Keep repository-wide best practices and gotchas documents updated dynamically to prevent future agent or human execution regressions.

task: Register scripts/memory/lifecycle.py in llms.txt root map
hurdles_regression: The new lifecycle CLI tool was omitted from the root onboarding map llms.txt.
resolution: Added references and operational description for scripts/memory/lifecycle.py under the Memory OS Kernel section in llms.txt.
lessons_learned: Always keep root onboarding documents and structural map indexes updated when adding new modules or core CLI utilities.

task: Fix memory validation loop continuation bug
hurdles_regression: Using global validity flag for loop continuation checks inside validate_memory.py caused evaluation to skip all remaining nodes/edges/events after the first failure.
resolution: Added local per-item boolean flags (node_ok, edge_ok, event_ok) for loop continuation checks, ensuring validator completes parsing files, and added unit test.
lessons_learned: Never use shared validation flags directly in loop continuation statements unless you intentionally want to halt traversal immediately.

task: Memory OS control-plane audit
hurdles_regression: Memory OS had validators, lifecycle tools, search, and capsules, but no single control-plane report tying handoff state, capsule metadata, lifecycle files, roadmap status, and next recommendations together.
resolution: Added `scripts/memory/audit_memos.py` with markdown and JSON output, focused tests, root-map registration, roadmap entry, and handoff routing to `memos giant`.
lessons_learned: Giant memos work should produce a control-plane view before adding more automation, otherwise product and Memory OS tracks drift independently.

task: Portable Memos CLI bootstrap
hurdles_regression: Memory OS commands were split across standalone scripts, making the future portable Memos kernel harder to initialize or integrate into arbitrary projects.
resolution: Added `scripts/memos.py` as a project-local CLI wrapper for init, integrate, audit, validate, and snapshot operations; added focused tests and root-map documentation.
lessons_learned: The portable Memory OS should expose one stable control CLI while keeping lower-level scripts available for specialized operations.

task: Method review proposal loop and naming guard
hurdles_regression: The roadmap asked for periodic method-review insight conversion, but background daemons remain blocked and the live repo had no review snapshot or experiment rows.
resolution: Added a dry-run-first proposal generator that converts repeated actionable method-review recommendations into deduplicated admin proposal rows only when `--write` is passed, wrapped it in analytics and Memos CLIs, created the current empty snapshot, and recorded a lifecycle event for the trusted control-plane change.
lessons_learned: Memory OS automation should separate snapshot creation, dry-run proposal review, write actions, and scheduler binding so autonomous loops remain inspectable and approval-gated.

task: Workflow quantizer 12-step alignment
hurdles_regression: The workflow contract and task capsules used the 12-step scale, but `quantize_task.py` still emitted only legacy 1-100 profiles such as small, standard, deep, and critical.
resolution: Preserved legacy scoring for compatibility while adding canonical `step_score` and `step_name`, updated workflow TOML specs with explicit step ranges, exposed `memos quantize`, and added focused CLI/workflow tests.
lessons_learned: Routing tools should emit the same metadata that handoff and capsule validators require; otherwise model tier decisions silently drift from the workflow contract.

task: Workflow manifest validation
hurdles_regression: Workflow TOML specs were parse-tested but not validated as a complete 12-step manifest, so quantizer routing could drift from workflow coverage without failing control-plane checks.
resolution: Added a workflow validator and `memos workflows` command, integrated workflow manifest errors into `memos validate` and `memos audit`, generated `memory/workflow_manifest.json`, and updated `memos init` to bootstrap valid TOML specs.
lessons_learned: Portable Memory OS installs need manifest validation at bootstrap time; otherwise a project can pass capsule and memory validation while lacking usable routing specs.

task: Generic phrase performance analytics primitive
hurdles_regression: Existing dashboard text analytics were tied to the YouTube `video_phrases` table and only exposed a narrower total-views/lift path, while the needed algorithm should work for any future source with text and metrics.
resolution: Added a generic in-memory n-gram scorer over arbitrary records, a read-only YouTube SQLite adapter, CLI command `phrase-performance`, markdown/json output, and focused tests for generic and YouTube paths.
lessons_learned: Phrase analytics should be source-agnostic at the scoring layer and keep YouTube-specific SQL isolated in an adapter so RSS, transcripts, comments, OCR, and external feeds can reuse the same metric engine.

task: Phrase performance chart API integration
hurdles_regression: The dashboard chart API still depended on the legacy `video_phrases` table path, which blocked source-agnostic phrase analytics and could fail when that derived table is absent.
resolution: Moved YouTube row-to-record mapping into the generic phrase-performance module, replaced the `/api/charts` phrase section with in-memory scoring over filtered video rows, preserved legacy frontend keys, added a richer `phrase_performance` n-gram block, and covered the route with a temp-DB test that omits `video_phrases`.
lessons_learned: Dashboard analytics should call the same generic scorer as CLI/reporting tools; source-specific tables should be optional acceleration layers, not required runtime contracts. Combined-source scoring must deduplicate phrases per record to avoid inflated counts.

task: Proposal workflow metadata plan
hurdles_regression: The proposal inbox currently mixes product feedback, Memory OS automation ideas, and admin/system-originated proposals in one file without durable workflow or authority metadata.
resolution: Recorded a plan to keep one file-backed proposal inbox for now while adding backward-compatible metadata fields for workflow, origin, authority, role title, and creator before considering physical module/file splits or full RBAC.
lessons_learned: Proposal classification should precede persistence splits; metadata filters reduce confusion without adding migrations, synchronization logic, or premature RBAC complexity.

task: Proposal metadata tags implementation
hurdles_regression: The proposal submission API allowed appending raw feedback, but had no validation or support for the newly planned workflow and role_tier metadata tags.
resolution: Added validation and support for optional workflow (product/memos) and role_tier (developer/automated/master_admin/admin/user) tags, defaulting to product and admin, and added focused integration tests.
lessons_learned: When implementing metadata tags on lightweight JSONL records, perform validation at the routing layer so that records in the inbox remain clean and query-friendly.

task: Memory OS schema evolution and progressive entitlements integration
hurdles_regression: Ensuring patch mock path in test_entitlements.py targets the actual source module app.state where get_entitlement_state is defined rather than routes actions where it is locally resolved.
resolution: Targeted app.state.get_entitlement_state in patching decorators and verified all tests pass.
lessons_learned: When testing locally imported methods inside route handlers, mock the source definition module directly to avoid mock path resolution failures.

task: Ingestion API foundation
hurdles_regression: The normalized connector layer existed, but product code had no stable API entrypoint for YouTube/RSS/manual ingestion and no entitlement-gated way to preview or persist connector output.
resolution: Added safe connector metadata and source ingestion endpoints, wired them to the existing connector registry, made ingestion dry-run by default, required operator_runtime for execution, required explicit allow flag for Tier E sources, and persisted records only to the isolated governance registry when persist=true with source_id.
lessons_learned: Ingestion should enter through one governed API surface before UI or scheduler work; dry-run previews keep connector experiments inspectable while avoiding writes to the main scraped database.

task: Compact Grid v1 regression stabilization
hurdles_regression: Compact Grid v1 introduced unbounded widget drag resizing and could overwrite widget state during restore; separate entitlement gating also made Administration appear missing for local/admin users.
resolution: Clamped widget width/height to workspace and viewport limits, added CSS max/min constraints and touch-action handling, skipped save calls during workspace restore, and made local/authenticated admin users keep operator runtime visibility in the UI state.
lessons_learned: Frontend layout persistence needs hard client-side bounds and restore-time write suppression; entitlement UI gates should not hide developer/admin surfaces in local admin mode without an explicit product decision.

task: Operator Runtime Ingestion Console UI
hurdles_regression: The source registry row action persisted ingestion immediately with only source_id, which did not match the dry-run-first backend contract and gave operators no controlled way to provide manual/RSS connector input or inspect normalized records before writes.
resolution: Added a bounded Operator Runtime Ingestion Console with source selector, connector metadata fetch, connector-specific input construction for manual/RSS/YouTube, dry-run preview, explicit persist action, Tier E approval checkbox, rendered result summaries, and static UI contract tests; row buttons now prepare a source instead of directly persisting.
lessons_learned: Product ingestion workflows should expose preview-first controls that mirror backend persistence semantics; source-row shortcuts should not perform writes when connector inputs, entitlement gates, and Tier E approvals can vary per run.

task: Copy-as-Brief Export
hurdles_regression: Brief exports could be downloaded, but the Phase 1 roadmap required a one-click copy flow with footnotes/citations; duplicating formatting only in JavaScript would have made copy and download diverge.
resolution: Moved copy-ready Markdown formatting into BriefsService export, added deterministic source footnotes, escaped HTML export output, added modal and history-row copy actions with clipboard fallback, localized the copy label, and covered backend/UI contracts with tests.
lessons_learned: Copy/export features should share one backend formatter so clipboard, file download, and future automations preserve the same citation contract.

task: Operator Runtime Source Records Surfacing
hurdles_regression: Persisted ingestion could create source_records and connector runs, but operators had no read-only UI surface to confirm what records were normalized without querying SQLite directly.
resolution: Added admin-gated GET /api/source-records with optional source_id filter and safe previews excluding metadata_json, then rendered recent records in Operator Runtime next to connector runs with focused API/UI tests.
lessons_learned: Every governed write path needs a nearby read-only audit surface; safe preview APIs should expose enough operational state to verify ingestion while withholding raw metadata and secret-bearing fields.

task: Saved Layouts & Synchronized Filters
hurdles_regression: Synchronizing widget date-picker changes across linked instances in vanilla JavaScript without triggering infinite propagation loops, and ensuring widget dimensions (width, height, collapsed) are preserved during DB state sanitization.
resolution: Implemented reciprocal link checking with skip-propagation guards on widgets link synchronization, and added width, height, and collapsed keys to ALLOWED_WIDGET_KEYS to pass sanitization filters in widgets.py.
lessons_learned: When implementing reciprocal state synchronization on separate frontend components, always include skip guards to break cascade loops. Ensure all layout-relevant keys are whitelisted in backend state sanitization filters.

task: Relocate widget close button
hurdles_regression: Ensuring querySelector finds the relocated buttons and that absolute positioning applies relative to the parent widget card.
resolution: Moved button tag to be a direct child of the card innerHTML and confirmed it is styled absolutely relative to the positioned dashboard-widget card.
lessons_learned: Avoid nesting absolutely positioned control elements in deeply nested flex structures if they need to align to the outer card bounds.

task: Update test execution autonomy rules
hurdles_regression: None.
resolution: Added explicit rules in .cursorrules and AGENT_RULES.md allowing autonomous test execution without asking for user approval.
lessons_learned: Keep behavioral guidelines updated to align with user delegation changes to prevent unnecessary roundtrips.

task: Memory OS Audit and Dependency Traversal Refactoring
hurdles_regression: Ensuring module import string matching handles package resolution boundaries correctly without false positive components matching.
resolution: Extracted complete package path imports in python AST analysis, and updated search_memory dependency matching to verify exact converted module strings.
lessons_learned: When implementing graph dependency routing, package level scopes should be resolved using full module paths to avoid over-matching blast radius to the top-level directory.

task: Proposal Auto-Transition and BaseStorage ISP Separation
hurdles_regression: None. Verification that theme and language features were already implemented allowed transitioning their proposals using the automated verification tests and logging lifecycle events cleanly.
resolution: Created test_themes.py and test_languages.py to verify proposals 1780268042454 and 1780268104255. Added memory nodes for these proposals to nodes.jsonl and ran audit to auto-transition. Segregated BaseStorage interface in db_client.py into IChannelRepository, IVideoRepository, and ISyncCoordinator repository contracts for SOLID compliance.
lessons_learned: Automating proposal transitions using tests in the nodes' evidence list guarantees that status updates are verified by code. Segregating wide database client interfaces into small repository contracts maintains full backwards compatibility while fulfilling SOLID principles.

task: Entity Extraction and micro-widget dashboard integration
hurdles_regression: The test case `test_alias_registration_and_merging` was failing because registering an alias name that already existed as a canonical entity left the old entity inside the canonical table and did not re-map references or sum metrics correctly. In offline testing, the LLM extraction service would attempt real API connection if a developer environment key was found in the environment.
resolution: Rewrote `/api/entities/aliases` to properly merge canonical entities into each other by updating all video entities references (summing mentions counts on duplicates), re-routing any aliases referencing the redundant canonical entry, and pruning the orphan canonical entity. Fixed `extract_entities_from_text` to check the mock flag first before attempting API key validation. Implemented three micro-widgets (Mini Stats grid, Entity Timeline tracks, System Status status dots) styled with grey-scale glassmorphism and i18n support.
lessons_learned: When deduplicating relational entities, always ensure all secondary reference tables (e.g. video_entities, entity_aliases) are completely updated and foreign-key references are handled before deleting the redundant canonical entry. Scoped DOM selectors in widget widgets are safer than global IDs to prevent collisions when multiple widget instances are spawned.

task: Staged Healthy Development & Company-Mode Governance Proposal
hurdles_regression: None.
resolution: Staged the proposal under the decisions folder and linked it in INDEX.md, adding explicitly that the Owner retains ultimate authority to modify details during review to avoid premature implementation of complex features.
lessons_learned: When reviewing large architecture guidelines, stage them as PROPOSED and document override channels so that Owner-level domain expertise is factored in before any automation rules are written.

task: Clarified Owner Intervention and Expertise Authority
hurdles_regression: None.
resolution: Added explicit rules in AGENT_RULES.md and strategy.md stating that the Owner retains the full right to override or intervene in details of any workflow pipeline step where they possess specific expertise.
lessons_learned: Explicitly documenting the boundaries of Owner authority prevents friction during agent workflow executions.

task: Memos Giant Steps: Proposal Validation and Roadmap Triage
hurdles_regression: Ensuring proposal records can be validated without bringing in full JSONSchema python library dependencies or modifying active database connections.
resolution: Implemented lightweight, native field validation matching the JSON Schema rules directly in python inside validate_memory.py, and integrated the checks into both validating and auditing CLI loops.
lessons_learned: When designing lightweight configuration or inbox contracts, native python validation checks avoid the overhead of heavy external package installations while keeping runtime checks robust.

task: Scheduler Binding (Manual Dashboard Proposals Trigger)
hurdles_regression: Integrating a scheduler cadence without introducing background worker overhead or unapproved API/token consumption, while still allowing operators to manually generate review proposals.
resolution: Implemented the POST /api/analytics/data-methods/proposals admin-gated REST API endpoint that triggers manual proposals generation and records them directly to the proposals file and memory lifecycle events. Integrated a new Proposals trigger button on the Operator panel, wired it via a UI spinner action to retrieve data, updated the global roadmap, and rebuilt the memory snapshot.
lessons_learned: Using explicit, manual dashboard actions (Option S1) allows scheduling checks without the CPU and token consumption risks associated with automatic background cron jobs or daemon processes.

task: Memory OS Knowledge Compaction & Graph Extraction
hurdles_regression: Processing a large backlog of uncompacted capsules (e.g., 47 rows) in a single LLM invocation causes token limit truncation and invalid JSON. Reciprocal incremental nodes also need to be accessible in intermediate batch loops.
resolution: Implemented batching (10 capsules/batch) and appended new draft nodes to nodes.jsonl incrementally per batch. Updated lifecycle transition validation to support connector, config, and policy types.
lessons_learned: Batching capsule logs prevents token truncation issues. Appending intermediate nodes to nodes.jsonl dynamically allows subsequent batches to discover and link them incrementally.

task: Memory OS Dual-Purpose Architecture & Language Gating
hurdles_regression: Ensuring prompt updates in both English and Ukrainian enforce the exact Russian exception rules without breaking parser formats.
resolution: Refined strategy.md, memory_os_architecture.md, and AGENT_RULES.md to strictly separate Developer Memory OS from User-Facing Memory OS. Added Global Language Policy instructions to system prompts and agent rules, blocking Russian generation and gating responses based on user language.
lessons_learned: Strict database-level isolation of Developer Memory OS from end-user memory avoids accidental leaks of codebase architecture to user chats. Gating instructions should be synchronized across all core prompts.

task: Memory OS Likes/Dislikes & Comments Feedback Loop
hurdles_regression: Fixing the news_scraper -> scraper package namespace rename validation errors in nodes.jsonl, and adding interactive feedback actions with custom comments in the client chat drawer without introducing database migrations.
resolution: Corrected outdated news_scraper evidence paths in nodes.jsonl. Updated the POST /api/chat/feedback route to accept custom comments and persist chat feedback memories into the isolated User-Facing memory_os.db database. Added feedback toolbar actions (like, dislike, export to Markdown) and comment input forms on the chat drawer bot message elements, backed by unittest discover coverage.
lessons_learned: User-Facing co-editor ratings and comments should be consolidated into the isolated memory_os.db telemetry layer. Code-verified proposal transition tests ensure clean roadmap integration.

task: Memory OS SOLID Dependency Inversion Principle Refactoring
hurdles_regression: None.
resolution: Introduced abstract interfaces for configuration, storage, and LLM providers. Implemented FileSystemMemoryStorage and DefaultLlmProviderService. Refactored compactor, lifecycle, validator, and search modules to accept injected abstract dependencies. Wrote mock-based unit tests running completely in-memory.
lessons_learned: Applying the Dependency Inversion Principle (DIP) in python by using abstract classes and constructor injection allows complex orchestration modules to be tested completely in-memory without disk I/O or active network requests, significantly improving speed, stability, and mock cleaness.

task: Phase 2 Cost & Quota Dashboard

lessons_learned: When introducing custom UI widgets, always register them in the backend type schemas to prevent serialization or verification errors in persistent layouts.

task: Memory OS CLI Extensions & Prompt Context Injection

resolution: Extended the main memos.py CLI with search, user-memory, and context commands for unified agent execution. Updated SystemPromptBuilder to query User-OS memories and inject them into the system prompt using a dependency-free YAML formatter while strictly filtering out developer codebase/symbol references.
lessons_learned: Consolidating CLI search and database management under a single entry point simplifies agent interaction, and dependency-free formatters prevent external packaging overhead.

task: Updated Global Roadmap with Completed Phase 2 and 3 Items

resolution: Checked off completed Phase 2 Cost & Quota Dashboard, and Phase 3 Evidence & OSINT features (Artifact Store, Timestamp & Hash Verification, Evidence Bundle Export, and Retention Locks) in the global roadmap.
lessons_learned: Keeping the roadmap accurate and up-to-date helps coordinate future developer and agent workstreams.

resolution: Created configs/watchers.config.json with primary/secondary watcher configurations. task: Scheduled Watchers Execution Runner

resolution: Implemented execute_watchers(root_dir) in governance.py which parses configs/watchers.config.json, filters enabled watchers, runs validation check, logs runs in connector_runs, and logs watcher.run event in audit_events using the same transaction connection.
